results.title: Thermorheologically Simple Material | Bohrium
results.snippet: A thermorheologically simple material is one whose viscoelastic properties at different temperatures can be interrelated by a simple time shift. This property allows the application of the Time-Temperature Superposition (TTS) principle to predict long-term material behavior, like creep or stress relaxation, from short-term experiments.
